title: PvP Limits
description: Limits items used in Minecraft PvP
body:
# PvP Limits

A Fabric server-side mod for limiting items used in PvP, made for [Attribute SMP](https://www.youtube.com/@AttributeSMPs)

> Allows adding a mace & spear damage cap, as well as a spear lunge cooldown.
> Custom item limits are planned.

- **Dependencies:**
    - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
    - [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

## Commands

- `/pvplimits reload`: Reloads the config file [Admin-only]
- `/pvplimits config`: In-game config editor [Admin-only]

## Config

Limits can be tweaked in `config/pvplimits.toml` or using the in-game config editor.
